posts.title: I always wanted to be an inventor when I grew up...
Oh, That's Why
posts.description: Me: "I wonder why the dishes always pile up around here." **an hour later** Me: "I was about to wash the crayon wax out of the cupcake pan my wife used for a 'Which things will melt?' experiment at the homeschool co-op, when I noticed that the sick three-year-old had fallen asleep and spilled his Gatorade. So I spent the time shampooing the couch instead."

posts.title: A Man Without Pier
posts.description: When I was younger 1 , I thought of myself as a man without pier. But after 19 bags of concrete mix and a ton of work with a post hole digger, my thoughts of myself have descended closer to the average: Two weeks ago ↩
